newsitem.title: GERMANY: Opel appoints new chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Opel appoints new chief financial officer.

text.p: Adam Opel AG, the German unit of U.S. carmaker General Motors Corp, said on Friday that Hennig Klages will become its new chief financial officer on September 1.
Opel said Klages will replace Gail Gunderson, 59, who has been appointed vice president for finance of General Motors Europe AG in Zurich.

Klages, 57, has been since 1994 director of finance and strategic planning at GM's Holden Automotive in Australia. He joined GM in 1956 at its South African subsidiary and has worked for the carmaker in London, Detroit and in Germany.
He was treasurer of Opel from 1984 to 1987, the company said in a statement.
